title.narrative: Blue Economy Pilot Project: Knowledge, Capacity Building, and Resilience for the Preservation of Natural and Cultural Heritage

description.narrative:
The project addresses the climate vulnerability of coastal communities in Angola, Chile, Jamaica, and Portugal by leveraging higher education for sustainable blue economy solutions.
Through the South-South University Cooperation Network (SUCN), it strengthens triangular cooperation among universities, public authorities, civil society, and communities through evidence-based, horizontal, and participatory co-design processes. This project aims to consolidate scientific knowledge regarding the coastal areas that are the subject of this work and to develop a work process that brings the scientific community closer to local communities, through the interaction of three main pillars:
i) scientific knowledge; ii) public policies for coastlines, and iii) local communities and knowledge.
Output 1 (Good practices): (3) Final Insight Documents on transferred good practices Output 2 (Blue Economy Framework): (5) Institutions equipped with a Collaborative Blue Economy Framework Output 3 (Academic): (4) Finalized, published research summaries Output 4 (Policy): (4) Completed and validated policy deliverables (policy maps/documents) Output 5 (Community): (4) Published community-based case studies Output 6 (Toolkit): (1) Final multilingual toolkit for Blue Economy resilience tested and validated in 4 communities (at least 30 members) at the country level Output 7 (Training): 75% of Participants report improved knowledge/confidence Output 8 (Forum): 100 Active users on the Blue Economy Forum Output 9 (Action Points): 80% of Action Points for improved South-to-South (SSC) / Triangular Cooperation (TrC) practices are implemented Output 10 (Participation): 40% of participants (Total, Youth, Female) in research/policy processes Output 11 (Dissemination): Final report + (4) Final dissemination materials highlighting youth and gender inclusion
